basics.name: Lasse Tange
basics.label: Tech Lead & Full-Stack Developer
basics.summary: Full-stack developer and tech lead with 15+ years planning, architecting and building web and mobile products. Most of my career has been spent in international startups and scale-ups in Berlin and Copenhagen — leading teams, owning architecture decisions, and helping early-stage companies grow into successful businesses. Since 2023 I have built and launched four AI products of my own, including the profitable SQLAI.ai (150,000+ users, 25M+ queries generated). Before that, a decade of client work across automotive marketplaces, crypto banking, e-learning, delivery apps and Danish public-sector platforms — from front-end architecture and design systems to APIs, search and geospatial data. I care about strong product thinking, a good eye for UX/UI, and code that stays simple, testable and maintainable. I lead with results over processes and personal responsibility over micro-management.

work.name: ViewDiff.ai
work.summary: Solo-built AI-assisted diff viewer for professional writers and editorial workflows. Shows original and AI-modified text side by side so writers can review and accept changes deliberately instead of trusting a black box. Built the diff engine, the generation flow and the subscription tiers. Key technologies: TypeScript, React, Node.js, LLM APIs, Stripe.
highlights: Defined the product concept and scope for an AI-assisted diff viewer aimed at professional writers
Designed and built the text diffing engine and the side-by-side review interface
Integrated LLM APIs for the text generation and rewriting flow
Implemented free tier, paid plans and subscription billing
Operated the product in production, including hosting, deployment and monitoring

work.name: SQLAI.ai
work.summary: Founded, built and operate a profitable AI-powered SQL workspace for generating, explaining, optimizing and validating SQL without losing control. Grown from first paying customer to 150,000+ users and 25M+ queries generated across 30+ database engines, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery and MongoDB. Sole engineer and operator across the full stack: text-to-SQL generation, query optimizer, validator and cross-engine converter; schema import and live database connections handling large schemas (900+ tables); schema-aware autosuggest, a VS Code-style editor and query diffing. Applied AI work spans RAG, embeddings, vector search and prompt design — always aimed at solving real business problems rather than producing demos. Also own the commercial side: Stripe and Lemon Squeezy billing, subscription lifecycle, SEO and paid acquisition. Key technologies: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Astro, Node.js, PostgreSQL, LLM APIs, RAG/vector search, Vercel, Cloudflare, DigitalOcean, Stripe, Lemon Squeezy.
highlights: Founded and built a profitable AI SQL workspace as sole engineer and operator
Designed and implemented text-to-SQL generation, query optimizer, validator, explainer and cross-engine converter
Built schema import and live database connections handling large schemas of 900+ tables
Implemented RAG, embeddings and vector search for schema-aware generation and autosuggest
Built a VS Code-style SQL editor with query diff viewing
Added and maintained support for 30+ database engines, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery and MongoDB
Owned architecture, infrastructure and deployment, scaling the product to 150,000+ users and 25M+ generated queries
Ran the commercial side: Stripe and Lemon Squeezy billing, subscription lifecycle, pricing, SEO and paid acquisition
